Summary

  • enable workspace conversion for existing Codex Agent Host sessions
  • keep workspaceless sessions read-only until a workspace is selected and confirmed
  • enable Codex structured user input in interactive mode and preserve thread history across conversion
  • share workspaceless guidance with the Copilot harness and cover launch, resume, failure, and conversion paths

Suppressed comments (2)

src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/codex/codexAgent.ts:1860

  • This ownership check also omits the workspace-less guidance for discovered/restored workspace-less chats whose directory is not host-owned. Those chats are marked workspace-less in session metadata but intentionally have no managedWorkingDirectory, so the model can attempt project-changing work without being told to call set_workspace. Use the session's actual workspace-less state rather than the cleanup ownership field.
		const developerInstructions = [
			customization.developerInstructions,
			session.managedWorkingDirectory ? AGENT_HOST_WORKSPACELESS_INSTRUCTIONS : '',
		].filter(instruction => instruction.length > 0).join('\n\n');

src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/codex/codexAgent.ts:5281

  • A restored Codex Desktop scratch chat can reach this materialization path with workspace-less metadata but no managedWorkingDirectory ownership marker. In that case thread/start/resume preparation does not force never plus read-only, contradicting the requirement that workspace-less sessions remain read-only until conversion. Base this decision on workspace-less session state, not managed-directory ownership.
		const resolvedPermissions = this._resolveSessionPermissions(configResource);
		const workspaceless = session.managedWorkingDirectory !== undefined;
		const approvalPolicy = workspaceless ? 'never' : resolvedPermissions.approvalPolicy;
		const sandboxMode = workspaceless ? 'read-only' : resolvedPermissions.sandboxMode;
